name: Bogotá
tagline: 1816 ajiaco, and a rumba with a grill that became Colombia's most famous restaurant.

La Puerta Falsa.description: Colombia's oldest restaurant, serving ajiaco and tamales since 1816 next to Plaza de Bolívar.

Andrés Carne de Res.description: An experience somewhere between restaurant and rumba in Chía, the most famous spot in Colombia according to travelers worldwide.

Leo Cocina y Cava.description: Haute cuisine built on Colombian biodiversity, from chef Leonor Espinosa.

El Chato.description: Contemporary cuisine with local produce from chef Álvaro Clavijo, in Zona G. Named best restaurant in Latin America in 2025.

Pajares Salinas.description: An icon of Spanish cuisine in Bogotá for more than 60 years, with an elegant, traditional atmosphere.
